pr_title: Add key binding to restart current track
pr_body:
Fix #6335 

**Proof of concept:** https://streamable.com/u208i

**Description:** Matching up the behaviour with stable. When track is running it'll restart the current track, when track is paused it'll resume the current track. For now it showing "Restart Track" and "Play Track" (stable only showing "Play")
pr_comments:
> Missing tests. (with asserts ensuring correct behaviour)

Will add the test

> Personally I don't like that `isRestart` exists. I'd advocate for moving the on-screen display calls somewhere inside to avoid all this execution path branching.

Yeah I'm concern about execution branching also. But not sure should I call it inside the function
What about checking instead (like `GlobalAction.MusicPlay`): `IsPlaying ? "Restart track" : "Play track"`

> What about checking instead (like `GlobalAction.MusicPlay`): `IsPlaying ? "Restart track" : "Play track"`

Doesn't help here. `MusicPlay` switches on the track state *after* performing the action (it can do that - it's a toggle), in this case the switch happens on the track state *before* - pressing this new binding will make *some* track play if `true` is returned, the question is if it was in progress (in which case the text should say `Restart`) or if it was not (in which case it should say `Play`)
Blocking pending UX discussion in issue.
Closing it for now, will create another PR with intended UX behavior

issue_context.title: Play from beginning hotkey is missing
issue_context.body: **Describe the new feature:** A hotkey that will seek to the start of the current song and starts playing it (It's F2 or X key in stable)
comments:
Check these out (*Settings → Input → Keyboard → Key configuration → Audio* section):

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20418176/65902798-79997380-e3bb-11e9-9a26-fdc85a3e6fb2.png)

Of course the default bindings aren't the same as in stable, but it is possible to rebind to your liking. Also see #5918 for a somewhat-related suggestion of adding common keyboard action support for the music player.

There are five keys used in stable. F1/Z for last track, F3/C for pause/unpause, F5/V for next track. These three are present in lazer. The next two (one I didn't know of) are missing, F2/X for seek to start and play, F4 for stop and seek to start. 

These are useful to have when searching for beatmaps in the song selection and then wanting to listen to the full song. (Because song selection uses preview points not track beginnings)

Some music players use the "previous" key to rewind to the start of the *current* track, and if you press it again in quick succession again, only then it will actually go to the previous track. Might that be a viable substitute for <kbd>F2</kbd>/<kbd>X</kbd>?

The <kbd>F4</kbd> binding seems marginally useful to me, but if the above behaviour was implemented it could be equivalent to pause + rewind.
Using previous key as rewind should be a config option. So that it would also apply to just clicking the ⏮️ on now playing overlay
Again, spurious addition of more and more config options is detrimental to both development and the end-user. There are plenty of settings already, no need to make more where there shouldn't be.
I tend to agree with the above stated logic change, as it is generally the expected UX for a music player these days.
I assume the decided behavior will be using prev button to restart and double click prev to jump to previous track, no?
